# Load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(cluster)
library(openxlsx)

```

# read data
```{r}
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5 <- read.xlsx("ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5.xlsx")
```

# Stratified Sampling and Overall Clustering
```{r}
# Loop 1: Generate N bootstrap samples
n_bootstraps <- 1000

set.seed(123)
boot_samples <- map(1:n_bootstraps, function(i) {
  ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5 %>%
    group_by(Group, Dose) %>%  # Replace with your actual group variables
    select(starts_with("ic")) %>% 
    slice_sample(prop = 0.8, replace = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
})
library(future) # Provides the plan() function
library(furrr)
library(progressr)
# Set up multi-core parallel processing
# plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)

# Loop 2: Parallelized PAM execution
k_value <- 4

# 2. CHOOSE HOW MANY SAMPLES TO CLUSTER
n_samples_to_run <- 50  # Change this to any number (e.g., 10, 100, length(boot_samples))
samples_subset <- boot_samples[1:n_samples_to_run]

```

```{r run-clustering, include=FALSE}
plan(sequential)
# Setup temp log file
log_file <- file.path("HARIRI", "pam_progress.log")
if (file.exists(log_file)) file.remove(log_file)
# Loop 2: Parallelized PAM execution
k_value <- 4

# 2. CHOOSE HOW MANY SAMPLES TO CLUSTER
n_samples_to_run <- 1000  # Change this to any number (e.g., 10, 100, length(boot_samples))
samples_subset <- boot_samples[1:n_samples_to_run]
# plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)

boot_results <- future_map2(
  samples_subset,
  seq_along(samples_subset),
  function(boot_sample, sample_id) {
    
    # Log START event
    cat(sprintf("[%s] STARTED  Sample #%d\n", Sys.time(), sample_id), 
        file = log_file, append = TRUE)
    
    feature_mat <- boot_sample %>% select(starts_with("ic"))
    
    fit <- pam(
      feature_mat, 
      k = k_value, 
      diss = FALSE, 
      metric = "manhattan", 
      stand = FALSE, 
      pamonce = 4
    )
    
    # Log FINISH event
    cat(sprintf("[%s] FINISHED Sample #%d\n", Sys.time(), sample_id), 
        file = log_file, append = TRUE)
    
    list(
      sample_id = sample_id,
      medoids   = fit$medoids,
      sil_width = fit$silinfo$avg.width
    )
  },
  .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE, packages = c("dplyr", "cluster"))
)

plan(sequential)
```

```{r print-log, echo=FALSE, comment=""}
# Print the log output cleanly inside your rendered document
cat(readLines(log_file), sep = "\n")
```
# Extract & Save Results to Disk
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)

# 1. Tidy all bootstrap medoids into a single long data frame
boot_medoids_df <- map_dfr(boot_results, function(res) {
  as.data.frame(res$medoids) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_id = res$sample_id,
      boot_cluster_id = row_number(),
      avg_sil_width = res$sil_width
    ) %>%
    relocate(sample_id, boot_cluster_id, avg_sil_width)
})

# 2. Save the dataframe to a CSV file on your laptop
output_dir <- "medoid_stability_results_80"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir)

write_csv(boot_medoids_df, file.path(output_dir, "bootstrap_medoids_80_1000.csv"))
cat("Saved bootstrap medoids to:", file.path(output_dir, "bootstrap_medoids_80.csv"), "\n")
```

# Match Bootstrap Medoids to Benchmark Medoids

```{r}
matched_results_2 <- boot_medoids_df %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_dfr(function(sample_df) {
  
  # Extract feature matrices (K x D)
  current_medoids <- sample_df %>%
    select(starts_with("ic")) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  gold_medoids <- as.matrix(medoids_clu4)
  
  # Rows = full-dataset medoids; columns = bootstrap medoids
  cor_matrix <- cor(
    t(gold_medoids),
    t(current_medoids),
    method = "pearson"
  )
  
  # Greedy matching: highest correlation first
  remaining_cor <- cor_matrix
  n_matches <- min(nrow(remaining_cor), ncol(remaining_cor))
  
  alignment_map <- vector("list", n_matches)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_matches)) {
    
    # Find the highest remaining correlation
    best_match <- which(
      remaining_cor == max(remaining_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
      arr.ind = TRUE
    )[1, ]
    
    gold_id <- best_match["row"]
    boot_id <- best_match["col"]
    
    alignment_map[[i]] <- tibble(
      boot_cluster_id = boot_id,
      matched_full_dataset_medoid_id = gold_id,
      correlation = cor_matrix[gold_id, boot_id],
      matching_order = i
    )
    
    # Prevent either medoid from being matched again
    remaining_cor[gold_id, ] <- NA_real_
    remaining_cor[, boot_id] <- NA_real_
  }
  
  alignment_map <- bind_rows(alignment_map)
  
  # Map the assignments back to the bootstrap rows
  sample_df %>%
    mutate(boot_cluster_id = row_number()) %>%
    left_join(alignment_map, by = "boot_cluster_id") %>%
    arrange(matched_full_dataset_medoid_id)
})

write_csv(matched_results_2, file.path(output_dir, "matched_bootstrap_medoids_2.csv"))
```

# Per-Medoid Correlation Distribution
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Compute correlation across features per matched pair
correlation_df_2 <- matched_results_2 %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Get feature vector of matched gold standard
    gold_vector = list(as.numeric(medoids_clu4[matched_full_dataset_medoid_id, ])),
    boot_vector = list(c_across(starts_with("ic"))),
    
    # Compute correlation
    pearson_r = cor(boot_vector, gold_vector, method = "pearson")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot the distribution density curves per Benchmark Medoid
ggplot(correlation_df_2, aes(x = pearson_r, fill = factor(matched_full_dataset_medoid_id))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(
    # title = "Bootstrap Stability: Correlation to Gold Standard Medoids",
    x = "Pearson Correlation (r)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Gold Medoid ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


```
# Per-Medoid Correlation Distribution
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Compute correlation across features per matched pair
correlation_df_2<- matched_results_2 %>%

    # Get feature vector of matched gold standard

    boot_vector = list(c_across(starts_with("ic"))),
    
    # Compute correlation
    pearson_r = cor(boot_vector, gold_vector, method = "pearson")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
correlation_df_2$Group <- factor(
  correlation_df_2$matched_full_dataset_medoid_id,
  levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4)
)

  aes(

) +

  ) +

)+

 )
```
